title: Skeletal mesh animation evaluation
fix_rationale: Skeletal animation evaluation costs scale directly with visible characters and bone counts; using URO (Update Rate Optimization) or Animation Budget Allocator reliably fixes sustained CPU animation overhead.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms updating animation poses and bone transforms ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Enable Significance Manager and Animation Budget Allocator plugin for crowded scenes.
Enable Update Rate Optimization (URO) on SkeletalMeshComponents to throttle tick rates for distant actors.
Set 'Visibility Based Anim Tick Option' to 'Only Tick Pose when Rendered' on offscreen meshes.

verify: Re-run in multi-character scenario and confirm SkeletalMeshComponent tick time decreases.
